content.short: Competitive trading card games using blockchain technology to facilitate digital ownership and governance for players.
content.description:
Our goal is to create a digital TCG that mixes iconic aspects from several game genres together to create a refreshing alternative to standard TCG gameplay. Balancing Blitz’s two primary resources, Gold and XP (experience), while choosing a General that compliments a player’s deck will ensure that there are always new strategies to explore.

We will do away with several of the silly NFT models that currently exist in the blockchain space and instead focus on fungible tokens and the benefit they bring to players. Nothing will be sold until the game is playable.

Gameplay First! Blitz is entirely self-funded and supported by a team of over 15 individuals. Play and Earn, not Play to Earn. Development updates, music, and more can be found on our YouTube. Blitz TCG is dual launching on both Cardano and Ergo in 2023.
